survey: A sports water bottle shown floating at a slight tilt, as an icon. Main parts: (1) A translucent blue plastic body with a narrow waist for grip, a raised wave-shaped grip line around the middle, and a flat, slightly thicker base. (2) Water inside, filling it to just below the shoulder. The water surface sits roughly level and reads correctly through the plastic. (3) A blue screw cap seated on the neck, with a short spout nub on top. (4) A loop handle molded into the cap, coming off one side as a closed ring you could carry it by. The cap fits squarely on the neck, and the loop is part of the cap rather than floating. The bottle floats in front of a sunburst background, which is a normal icon pose and needs no support. Left and right sides of the body match, and the base is round.
